classification.difficultyReason: Interpret one-third as one equal part and the remaining ribbon as two equal parts.

content.prompt: The diagram below shows a ribbon. One-third of the ribbon is blue. Give the ratio (length of blue section):(length of white section).

spec.description: Horizontal ribbon with its left third blue and right two-thirds unfilled. TikZ preserves the single internal boundary; the fraction-grid template would add a boundary within the white section.
spec.mathematics: The boundary is at one-third of the total length. There are no labels or extra divisions.
spec.answerVisibility: The coloured section is a permanent given; no answer is printed.

answer.worked:
Divide the ribbon into three equal parts. The blue section occupies one part and the white section occupies two parts.
$$\text{blue length}:\text{white length}=1:2$$
